groups.rationale: Reviewed merge: SCIM completion changed only SCIM rows in chapters 19-21; upstream ADR-0243 native durability (growth, power-cut replay, relocation), FreeBSD racing-reset fencing and OmniOS Nix KVM assembly in chapters 07, 17, 19 and 20 add guest evidence without changing system architecture; ADR-0246 topology views already regenerated.

Rebased on trunk ed9a5bb9. Chapter 20 documents Marshall PostgreSQL and SMTP TLS defaulting to the operating-system trust store instead of castore, so the eMudhra distrust applies. Evidence: config and runtime-config unit tests; BEAM only.
Rebased on trunk ed9a5bb9. Shared chapter 20 gains Marshall system-trust defaults only; no protocol source, wire format or evidence changes.
Rebased on trunk ed9a5bb9. Shared chapter 20 gains Marshall-only TLS trust notes; Lilly fences, storage and isolation evidence are unchanged.
Rebased on trunk ed9a5bb9. Lyra moves to rustls-webpki 0.103.16 with an updated vendor hash; it still uses rustls-native-certs and documented behavior is unchanged.

Reviewed merge: upstream eMudhra root distrust (all eight hosts, NixOS guests, kexec installer) is already documented in chapter 12 and was recorded upstream. Local: fleet profile enables programs.direnv so interactive shells hook direnv system-wide (contract fleet-direnv-shell-hook, storage-configuration evaluation check); the handbook does not document the fleet toolset and .envrc approval stays explicit.
Rebased on trunk ed9a5bb9. AGENTS.md carries a temporary checklist of eMudhra follow-ups; no documented behavior, check or evidence changes.
